meta_description:
7,021 likes, 60 comments - nikhilkamathcio on October 25, 2026: "Is AI the biggest revolution of our lifetime, or just the most expensive bubble we’ve ever created?

Sat down with Akshay Kothari, co-founder of Notion ($11B), Vijay Krishnan, co-founder of Turing ($2.2B), and Anna Goldie and Azalia Mirhoseini, the former Google researchers who helped pioneer AI-designed chips and went on to build Ricursive Intelligence ($4B).

We went from hardware to training models to applications. Essentially, the entire AI food chain.

Is this all hype? Are our jobs going away? And more importantly, can India actually make money from any of this?

Figured I’d ask the people building it, rather than the people selling it.

Early to the revolution or late to the bubble?

Episode out now..".
